Failed or missing flashing at the chimney or roof-to-wall joints
Deck ledger board not bolted or flashed
Wood rot at exterior trim, fascia or door frames
Negative grading directing water toward the foundation
Structure and moisture
Active water intrusion in the basement or crawlspace
Soft or water-damaged subfloor
Evidence of wood-destroying insect activity or damage
Torn or missing crawlspace vapor barrier
Systems

Heating system did not respond to the thermostat
Air conditioning system not cooling adequately; evaluation by an HVAC contractor recommended
Bathroom exhaust fan vents into the attic
